type: centrifugal, backward-curved RadiCal impeller, single inlet, AC motorized impeller (no integral scroll housing)
housing: no integral scroll housing — motorized impeller (plug fan) requiring external housing or ducted integration
max_airflow_source_50hz: TME product listing — consistent with RS Online UK (705 m³/h at 230V, 50 Hz). Multiple sources agree on 705 m³/h at 50 Hz. CONFIRMED as the correct 50 Hz free-delivery flow.

max_airflow_m3h_discrepancy.resolution: The RS Online US listing specifies 2600 RPM and 210W — these are the 60 Hz values. 766 CFM × 1.699 m³/h/CFM = 1301 m³/h at 60 Hz. Speed-ratio scaling predicts: 705 × (2600/2500) = 732 m³/h — lower than the 766 CFM figure, suggesting the RS Online US value may include a different impeller depth (99mm vs 101mm) or listing inaccuracy. Regardless, 705 m³/h at 50 Hz is the most consistently cited figure across multiple independent sources and is the correct value for 50 Hz operation.

dimensions_mm: 225 mm diameter x 101 mm depth (50 Hz variant, RS Online UK); 225 mm diameter x 99 mm depth (60 Hz variant, RS Online US)
max_static_pressure_source: Secondary source (search result summary citing distributor data). INDICATIVE ONLY — not directly extracted from manufacturer PDF. Must be confirmed from ebm-papst datasheet.

noise_condition: RS Online US listing — measurement conditions not confirmed
india_availability: ebm-papst India PVT LTD and MS Enterprises (New Delhi) cited as distributors. This specific model not confirmed in India stock — requires direct inquiry.
integration_note: Motorized impeller (plug fan) design — no integral scroll housing. Requires mounting inside an enclosure or duct. Suitable for plenum or free-inlet installation. Airflow enters through the impeller face and exits axially.
source_document_primary: RS Online UK and US product listings; TME listing; Mouser specsheet PDF and ebm-papst operating instructions PDF (both attempted in Phase 6C — binary content, not extractable)
evidence_level_rationale: Remains C after Phase 6C. Airflow (705 m³/h at 50 Hz) confirmed from multiple distributor sources. Motor specs (PA6 impeller, 7 blades, 3.5 µF capacitor, F insulation) added from TME in Phase 6C. Max static pressure (425 Pa) still from secondary source only. Fan curve not extracted — both PDF sources returned binary. Evidence C: distributor data with partial confirmed specs but no manufacturer fan curve.
suitability_assessment: TIER 2 — POTENTIALLY SUITABLE. Backward-curved RadiCal design (non-overloading). 705 m³/h free delivery at 50 Hz is adequate for single-unit flow if system resistance brings operating Q to ~400-600 m³/h, or two units would deliver ~1200-1400 m³/h. Cited 425 Pa max static pressure (unconfirmed) covers Scenario L and possibly M. Cannot be confirmed without reading the manufacturer performance datasheet. Priority: obtain fan curve from a readable PDF source.
recommended_action: Attempt to obtain the R2E225-RA92-09 fan curve from an alternative source (not mouser.com or img.ebmpapst.com — both returned binary PDFs). Try ebm-papst India direct contact, or check TME for a downloadable datasheet. If fan curve is confirmed at ≥400 Pa shutoff head, advance to Tier 1.
phase_6c_update: 2026-09-05 — Airflow discrepancy partially resolved (705 m³/h at 50 Hz confirmed). Motor specs updated (PA6 impeller, 7 blades, 3.5 µF, F insulation). PDF fetch attempts both returned binary — fan curve not obtained. Evidence remains C.
